title: bromus erectus subvar. montenegrinus
intro: Bromus erectus subvar. montenegrinus, commonly known as Montenegrin erect brome, is a subspecies of the plant Bromus erectus. It is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The health benefits of Montenegrin erect brome include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as diabetes and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, while its bioactive constituents include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites.
